model_name: ShelfLife AI Selected Global Random Forest Regression
target_interpretation: Observed perishable-product demand proxy from FreshRetailNet-50K; not actual restaurant ingredient consumption.
future_operational_target: Aggregated ShelfLife AI UsageRecord.quantityUsed history once sufficient system-specific operational data exists.
known_limitations: Stockout-induced demand censoring is not corrected; the model forecasts observed demand rather than unconstrained latent demand.
The seven-day Dataset A EVAL partition is an evaluation benchmark and does not define the production forecasting horizon.
FreshRetailNet-50K stock information is not mapped directly to ShelfLife AI InventoryBatch.
Inventory and expiry risk classification remains deterministic downstream business logic.
